name: Liliana the Repentant
description: A ruthless former planeswalker haunted by those she could not save, who now tries to support the greater good; she is a necromancer-turned-professor held prisoner in the Echoverse.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana is kidnapped by her double on Strixhaven and held prisoner in the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: is being held prisoner in the Echoverse, having been kidnapped by her doppelgänger on Strixhaven
